notes: v1.1.121: (1) m-mode relogin keeps its saved login: after a password change / unlock Facebook drops the saved login but the old token stayed, so the app skipped Save and every relogin typed UID + password again - now Facebook's 'Save your login info' is always answered and a fresh token is confirmed, so the next relogin is the account's own Continue. (2) Any task that gets a Facebook code step (language change, Accounts Center removals, page access send/accept, any Warm Up 24/7 step) now answers it from the account's 2FA key or its mailbox; an SMS step switches to app/e-mail when possible, and when it can't be answered the reason is written to Status Detail. (3) Browser device location is ON at the proxy's town (each account at its own fixed spot), so posts check in with the location and Facebook sees the account's town; a failed check-in is retried once. Emulator stories now add a location now and then. (4) Captcha no longer wastes minutes: the reCAPTCHA picture solve runs first (seconds), the token only as fallback, Google's puzzle is finished inside its 2-minute window, a flagged profile stops after 3 rounds, and an unsolved captcha isn't retried on the same proxy. Carries 1.1.120: 956 reasons, forced new password saved, cookie after unlock, light theme.
